title: Grow the Harness, Not the Context: From Strategy-Free Scaffolds to Reusable Specialist Agents
title_zh: 扩展执行框架，而非上下文：从无策略脚手架到可复用专家智能体
abstract_en: Large language model (LLM) agents often handle streams of related tasks, yet standard harnesses repeatedly ask the model to reconstruct the same control decisions inside each task's context. We study whether task feedback can instead turn recurring control into reusable executable code, while reserving LLM calls for task-specific semantic reasoning. We introduce Growing Harness, a failure-guided training paradigm that learns the agent harness itself from a strategy-free scaffold that exposes fixed model and tool interfaces but encodes no task-solving controller. Function-level execution traces localize each failure to a bounded code surface, an optimizer repairs a window of failures jointly, and a success-first held-out gate rolls back repair sequences that harm prior capability. Accepted edits accumulate in one shared harness, allowing its control structure to emerge from task feedback. Across BrowseComp-Plus and WebArena-Verified with three deployment models from 4B to 120B parameters, Growing Harness achieves the highest mean success in five of six benchmark-model settings and trails the best mean by 0.7 pp. in the sixth. Relative to a Tool-Calling agent, it reduces LLM calls by 76.0-91.8% and deployed-agent inference cost by 74.4-98.6%. On WebArena-Verified, its success remains 44.7-45.3% across model scales, whereas Tool-Calling falls to 6.7% with the 4B model. Ablations show that trace-local edits, joint repair, and gate-based rollback each improve final success. These results show that persistent program growth can move recurring control out of model context and into low-cost code, yielding reusable specialist agents that remain effective with smaller deployment models.
abstract_zh: LLM 智能体常需连续处理一系列相关任务，但标准执行框架（harness）通常要求模型在每个任务的上下文中反复重建相同的控制决策。本文提出 Growing Harness，一种由失败驱动的训练范式：从仅提供固定模型与工具接口、不包含任务求解控制器的无策略脚手架出发，利用任务反馈将重复出现的控制逻辑沉淀为可复用的可执行代码，同时仅将任务特定的语义推理保留给 LLM。该方法通过函数级执行轨迹将失败定位到有限的代码范围，由优化器联合修复一组失败，并使用“成功优先”的留出集门控机制回滚损害既有能力的修复序列。通过持续累积通过验证的代码修改，共享执行框架能够从任务反馈中逐步形成控制结构。在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 WebArena-Verified 上，针对参数量从 4B 到 120B 的三种部署模型，Growing Harness 在六种基准—模型组合中的五种取得最高平均成功率，在剩余一种中仅落后最佳结果 0.7 个百分点。相比 Tool-Calling agent，该方法减少了 76.0%–91.8% 的 LLM 调用，并将部署智能体的推理成本降低 74.4%–98.6%。在 WebArena-Verified 上，其成功率在不同模型规模下稳定保持在 44.7%–45.3%，而 Tool-Calling 使用 4B 模型时降至 6.7%。消融实验表明，基于轨迹的局部编辑、联合修复和门控回滚均能提升最终成功率。结果说明，将重复控制逻辑从模型上下文迁移到低成本代码中，可构建能够复用、且适配小型部署模型的专家智能体。
key_points_zh: 提出 Growing Harness：从不含求解策略的脚手架出发，根据任务失败持续学习并扩展智能体的可执行控制代码。
利用函数级执行轨迹进行局部故障定位，联合修复多个失败，并通过留出集门控与回滚保护已有能力。
在 BrowseComp-Plus 和 WebArena-Verified 的六种基准—模型组合中，五种取得最高平均成功率，另一种仅落后 0.7 个百分点。
相较 Tool-Calling agent，LLM 调用减少 76.0%–91.8%，部署推理成本降低 74.4%–98.6%。
性能对模型规模不敏感：WebArena-Verified 成功率在 4B–120B 模型间保持约 44.7%–45.3%，显示其适合小模型部署。

llm_assessment.comment: This is exceptionally strong agent-harness research that evolves reusable control code through failure-localized traces, joint repair, and rollback gates.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 这是一项非常出色的智能体框架研究，通过失败定位轨迹、联合修复和回滚门控演化出可复用的控制代码。
